solution:
Correct option: (a) visual arts.

Section 4.2 of the chapter opens with the sentence ‘The art of painting and sculpting are visual arts.’ The chapter divides artistic creations into two types, Visual Arts (Drik Kala) and Performing Arts (Lalit or Aangik Kala); painting and sculpture belong to the first. Folk art and classical art are the two traditions of art, not the two types, so they do not answer this question.

The chapter says ‘The 1st-3rd century C.E., that is the Kushana period, saw the rise of Mathura school of art.’ It adds that the Mathura school laid the foundation of Indian iconography. During the Gupta period the iconographic rules were formulated and standards for sculptural art were set, which is a later stage.
